Krishna Iyer (student_id: S2025CS003) cannot renew their hostel room for next year [Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3]. 

To be eligible for hostel renewal, all of the following conditions must be met:
1. CGPA of 6.0 or higher at the time of renewal [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3]: Your current CGPA is 7.45 (which is $\ge 6.0$), so you meet this condition [SQL].
2. No overdue fee dues of any kind in the fee ledger [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3]: You do not meet this condition because you have an overdue fee entry in your fee ledger [SQL].
3. No more than one recorded disciplinary warning in the current year [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3].

Your current overdue fee details:
| Component | Amount Due | Outstanding Balance | Due Date | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tuition_inst1 (txn_id: 90) [SQL] | ₹87,000 [SQL] | ₹87,000 [SQL] | 14 Aug 2026 [SQL] | overdue [SQL] |

Additionally, please note that the renewal window runs from 1 April to 30 April 2027 [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3].
sql: SELECT s.cgpa, f.txn_id, f.component, f.amount_due, f.amount_paid, (f.amount_due - f.amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, f.due_date, f.status FROM students AS s JOIN fee_ledger AS f ON s.student_id = f.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS003' AND f.status = 'overdue' LIMIT 200
